text:
Alex: Preflight — late patch (hotfix) queued for 03:30 UTC. Need a quick SLO sanity + runbook check before we push. Small KV schema tweak, short shard migration. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/pr/1234. @Priya can you confirm rollback steps? @Sam are you oncall?
Priya: Looking now. Quick Q — will this require a full serving node restart or just the migration job that takes a shard lock? If restart, we should schedule after 03:45.
Sam: I'm oncall. If it's just the migration job we can do rolling. If restart, that bumps paging risk. Do we have a canary route to limit blast radius?
Alex: No node restarts — migration job only. Plan: (1) mark canary traffic reduction (2) run migration job per-shard (3) wait for KV warmup (4) restore traffic. Rollback plan: revert traffic changes + run reverse migration. Commands below.
Alex: ```
# deprecate 50% traffic to canary
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.dev/api/v1/routes/deprecate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"embed-service","percent":50}'
# run migration for shard 12
kubectl -n infra exec job/migrate-kv -- /app/migrate --shard=12 --mode=apply
# warmup embed route
python tools/warmup.py --route embed-service --concurrency 20
```
Priya: Copy. I'll tail logs and watch for failures. Suggest adding +5m buffer for SLO burn in the preflight checklist.
Maria: PR looks good, LGTM. I can take rollback if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment started for pr-1234 — CI passed (412/412). Build: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/98765 :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll put the pager on standby. Abort conditions: error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR 99p latency > 120ms. If that happens, we'll cut traffic and trigger rollback. Watch `slo-latency`, `kv-evict-rate`.
Alex: Thanks. Quick checklist for the preflight at 03:25 UTC in #eng-sre: 1) snapshot metrics (baseline) 2) notify customers channel 3) deprecate traffic -> 50% 4) run migration shard-by-shard 5) validate 99p latency <= 120ms 6) rollback threshold enforced. Add anything?
Priya: Add runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/kv-migrate — note: evictions can spike during warmup, watch `kv-evict-rate` and `cache-hit` metrics.
Sam: Oncall note: if we observe 504s, switch canary to fallback model id and escalate to infra pager. I'll be ready to flip traffic.
Alex: Great — see you at preflight. :coffee:
